IMPLEMENTED.meaning: The computation is wired, persistent, tested and approved in the Cy Soma specification.

PROVISIONAL.meaning: Working plumbing or an older heuristic exists, but it is not an approved grounded model.

soma_variables.status_note: The displayed anxiety value is still produced by the older heuristic experienced-state model. A separate grounded probabilistic threat-prediction dependency is LIVE, but no approved mapping converts it into anxiety.
Currently produced by the older heuristic experienced-state model. No grounded stress-load specification has been approved.
Injury and discomfort plumbing exists, but the current magnitude and recovery rules are unapproved heuristics.

A deterministic ensemble implements the published stomach, intestinal, CCK, GLP-1, PYY, ghrelin and physiological satiety equations. It reports an input-uncertainty range and does not model subjective hunger.

Predicts Karolinska Sleepiness Scale ratings with the validated TPM S_B + C + U equations from observed sleep-wake history. Runtime status remains CALIBRATING until two complete observed sleep episodes exist. This is not general fatigue or a direct report of subjective experience.

A factual social contact detector and ledger are LIVE separately. The displayed Loneliness value remains the older arbitrary baseline, contact/rejection impulses and elapsed-time clock; no approved model converts social history into subjective loneliness.
Currently produced by older event and relationship heuristics. No grounded anger/appraisal specification has been approved.

The current unresolved-event and repeated-output mechanism is an unapproved heuristic retained for labelled UI diagnostics only. Generated wording no longer changes live attention, memory selection, action, timing, prompt focus or drawing.

soma_subsystems.status_note: A compact engineering projection sends factual outputs from LIVE grounded substrates to the language model with explicit epistemic labels. It introduces no emotion score, threshold, weight or psychological mapping, and generated expression cannot update grounded state.

The model-mediated expressive chooser receives the same factual Handoff-11 projection with epistemic labels. No heuristic visitor-facing metric, drive, salience score or emotion mapping is supplied to the chooser.

A small structured model call chooses only among currently available journal, draw and silence capabilities. The result is character behaviour, not a grounded measurement, reward policy, utility model or psychological action-selection model.
The old arbitrary drive-weight selector remains as compatibility and diagnostic code only. The live runner does not call it and it no longer selects journal, drawing or silence.

The eight provisional visitor-facing metrics remain available to labelled UI diagnostics. They no longer alter waking prompts, expressive choice, silence duration, drawing subject/style, sampling, output length or mishearing probability.
The former 45 + 180 * Rest rule is disabled. Model-selected silence uses a fixed engineering autonomous-activity interval and does not read psychological state.
Legacy token associations may still be recorded and displayed, but they cannot alter appraisal, prompt context, attention, memory selection, action or timing.
Legacy attention values remain diagnostic state only. No attention text or numeric salience is supplied to the live prompt or expressive chooser.

A heuristic retriever may surface optional continuity material only when it resolves to a real structured environment-event ID, timestamp, kind and exact archived event text. Generated prose and heuristic reinterpretations are excluded.
No approved grounded episodic-memory model exists.
No approved grounded attention or salience model exists.
No approved grounded rumination model exists.
No grounded perception or mishearing model exists. Occasional ambiguous variants are a fixed fictional-world mechanic with engineering provenance.
No scientific or grounded action-selection model exists. Expressive form is now a separately classified subjective character-model choice; prison instrumental choice remains engineering round-robin.

A parameter-free Beta-Bernoulli learner updates separate structured cue and adverse-outcome associations from resolved environment trials. It predicts outcomes; it is not anxiety, fear intensity, arousal, or brain activation.
The live learner assumes stationary cue-outcome contingencies. No volatility, reversal, forgetting, or dynamic learning-rate model is implemented.
No similarity, cue generalisation, latent-context inference, or context-switching model is implemented.
The learner updates explicitly identified cue and outcome pairs independently. No latent-context or contextual-inference model is implemented.

An event-driven vector keeps present external cues, separate learned cue-outcome posteriors, categorical imminence, world ambiguity, objective control and outcome resolution inspectable without producing a threat or anxiety score.
Reports only the categorical control affordance explicitly supplied by the structured world: none, limited, substantial or unknown. It is not perceived control.

Structured world records explicitly identify a comparable context, actions that were actually available, the chosen and executed action state, timestamps and resolved outcomes. Missing action data is never treated as deliberate inaction.

Five existing officer and inmate incident types now open explicit two-action opportunities, persist the selected action, and resolve through distinct deterministic world consequences on the following world tick. No outcome probabilities or emotional effects are introduced.

Current prison-world actions are selected by a persisted engineering round-robin so both available branches can be exercised. This is not a psychological, behavioural or scientifically grounded choice model.
No grounded model estimates Cy's subjective belief about control.

Separate Beta-Bernoulli posteriors compare adverse outcomes after an explicitly available action was executed versus deliberately not executed in the same structured context. This is observational association, not causal or perceived control.
Observed conditional differences do not prove that Cy's action caused an outcome because actions are not randomly assigned and situations may be confounded.
No comparison of context-only and context-plus-action predictive models, fitted participant parameters, prior odds or Pavlovian-instrumental arbitration is implemented.

Learned action-outcome evidence does not select Cy's actions. Matching current-context evidence may be included factually in the grounded prose prompt, without becoming causal control, perceived control or an action policy.

A categorical engineering ontology records potential, imminent, ongoing, resolved or unknown temporal status from structured facts. It is informed by threat-imminence theory but is not a numeric biological scale.
Only externally present structured cues can open a current defensive context. Psychological reactivation by memory or imagination is not modelled.
Canonical structured events preserve stimulus, body-site, tissue-harm, injury-status, observation and explicit unknown fields without assigning subjective Pain.
Represents observed mechanical, thermal, chemical, other or unknown stimulus modality and categorical noxious status. It is a world-fact representation, not biological nociception.
Persists stable post-installation injury identities, origin, site, mechanism, status, follow-ups, resolution and provenance. No healing is inferred from elapsed time.
A functional computational analogue that carries structured noxious-input facts. Cy has no biological nociceptors, and this is neither nociception nor subjective Pain.
Elapsed time never heals an injury. Resolution requires an explicit structured follow-up naming the stable injury identity.
No model converts noxious input or injury facts into a subjective Pain experience. The separate public Pain / Discomfort value remains a provisional legacy heuristic.
No grounded model combines injury, environmental discomfort, hunger, fatigue or other bodily facts into a general discomfort state.
No Bayesian, predictive-processing or reinforcement-learning model of Pain perception is implemented.
Repeated events do not change peripheral gain, thresholds or later responses.
Repeated events do not change central gain, thresholds or later responses; allodynia and hyperalgesia are not modelled.
Noxious-input and injury facts do not select withdrawal, guarding, avoidance or any other action.
Somatic input is an available future dependency only. No insula activation is derived from it.
No subjective Pain, Pain affect or anterior-cingulate activation mapping is implemented.
No descending Pain modulation or PAG activation mapping is implemented.

Canonical structured records distinguish scheduled expectation, food offering, availability, receipt, full or partial consumption, refusal, unavailability and unknown intake without converting them to Hunger.
Persists complete post-installation objective meal and intake records, last known intake, exact observed portions and explicit unknowns.
Tracks scheduled food unavailability, refusals and unknown intake separately, including explicit runner-observation gaps. It contains no deprivation magnitude.
No calibrated internal physiological state H, preferred state H*, depletion dynamics or food-to-physiology outcome K exists for Cy.

Implements the published GI compartments, nutrient transit, CCK, GLP-1, PYY, ghrelin and physiological satiety equation as a deterministic uncertainty ensemble for a metabolically healthy adult reference.
No sensory, reward-value or hedonic feeding model exists.
The prison meal schedule is an environmental expectation only; no anticipatory appetite model exists.
The grounded ledger does not select food-seeking, eating or refusal actions.
Cy's metabolic expenditure, body mass, digestion, meal-equivalent energy and gastric dynamics are not calibrated or assumed.
Normalized Process S integrates actual observed sleep and wake intervals using the published Two-Process exponential formulation. It is not a measure of subjective fatigue.

Implements the published S_B + C + U Three-Process Model and KSS transfer equation. It consumes only structured observed sleep-wake history, requires two complete observed sleep episodes, uses population-default phase, and remains CALIBRATING until that evidence exists.

The older heuristic fatigue scalar is retained only for state compatibility and private diagnostics. It does not feed public primary state, prompts, actions, environment, brain analogies, compatibility vitals or another grounded subsystem.
No validated general-fatigue construct is implemented.
The Three-Process Model W component is not used. Sleep inertia is not modelled.
Published five-harmonic Process C waveform. Biological phase is not observed; a circular phase interval is estimated from the configured habitual wake schedule and shown with uncertainty.
No light/zeitgeber phase-response model or free-running phase drift is implemented. Process C is treated as stably entrained to the configured prison schedule.
Canonical factual social episodes preserve channel, form, direction, reciprocity, character and resolution without calculating social need.
Persistent post-installation social contact, opportunity, isolation and observation-gap history.
Derives current factual social context from canonical episodes only.
Records social opportunities separately from actual contact outcomes.
Accepts isolation only when continuous observation, aloneness and no contact are all explicitly established.
Cy's individual preferred amount and quality of contact are unknown.
No set-point comparison or deficit calculation exists.
No chronic adaptation rate or mechanism is implemented.
No individual tolerance or dynamic range is modelled.
Hostility, rejection and isolation are not assigned a common subjective magnitude.

brain_regions.status_note: The mammalian SCN is the principal circadian pacemaker. This specific display represents Cy's modelled Process C phase and output; it is not simulated neuronal firing, activation, or biological measurement.

Grounded threat prediction and current external defensive-context subsystems are LIVE, but no approved mapping turns them into amygdala firing or activation. The older displayed mapping remains an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
No BNST activation model or supported artwork mapping exists. Current ambiguity and temporal status are possible future dependencies only.
No PAG activation or defensive-response model exists. Categorical imminence is a possible future dependency only.
An action-outcome contingency substrate is LIVE, but perceived control and neural activation remain NOT MODELLED. The statistical ledger is not a model of vmPFC firing or regulation.

Intended to represent interoceptive processing. Feeding input history is now available as a future dependency, but no internal physiological or gut state is modelled. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
GI and hormonal physiological satiety modelling is LIVE separately, but AgRP/NPY, POMC and hypothalamic neuronal activity remain NOT MODELLED. The satiety score does not illuminate this region.

The live threat learner provides expected outcome, uncertainty, and outcome surprisal as possible future dependencies, but no approved anterior-cingulate mapping exists. The older displayed mapping remains an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.
Intended to represent active contextual and episodic-memory computation. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.

Intended to represent regulation and action-control processes. Objective control and observational action-outcome contingency are represented separately, but perceived control and neural regulation remain unmodelled. The displayed runner mapping is an unapproved inverse linear heuristic and is not shown as live activation.

The factual social contact ledger is available as a future dependency, but no approved distributed neural activation mapping exists. The older runner mapping simply mirrors provisional Loneliness and is not shown as live activation.
